clips.title: The story
paras: Gnomes hold the Clean Zone as a refuge inside ruined Gnomeregan. Beyond the upper Hall of Gears, this fortified enclave remains safe amid the irradiated city, where medics, technicians, and Sparklematic machines support the defenders and salvage work.

The Clean Zone remains untainted while most of Gnomeregan fell to Mekkatorque's disastrous venting of radioactive waste. It lies between the trogg-infested Dormitory below and the contested corridors of the Hall of Gears above. Gnome defenders, technicians, and field medics hold its barricades day and night. Alliance expeditions can regroup here, tend their wounds, and maintain their machinery.

The Clean Zone also supports salvage from Gnomeregan's ruined capital. Gnomish engineers installed Sparklematic 5200 units to scrub and wash grime-encrusted relics brought up from the city's radioactive depths. Technicians and merchants such as Tink Sprocketwhistle process the reclaimed gears and baubles, outfit adventurers, and study the toxic fallout in the deep tunnels.
